description: This file defines the Return class, a method operation for handling return logic in the MiniLang framework within the OFBiz project. It implements the processing of the <return> element in MiniLang scripts, including extracting and expanding response codes and setting environment variables accordingly.

classes.name: Return
classes.description: Implements the <return> element as a MethodOperation, handling response code expansion and environment variable setting based on the MiniLang script execution context.

classes.name: Return.ReturnFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Return instances.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Return operation by validating attributes and setting up response code expansion.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the return operation: determines response code, expands it, and stores it in the environment based on method type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Return element, including the response code attribute if not default.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create Return instances from XML elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the element this factory creates ('return').
